description:
Offline speech-to-text based on Handy with extra voice dictation improvements.

Handy Voice is a fork of Handy, an open source offline speech-to-text desktop app, with extra voice dictation, overlay, Windows startup, and sound theme improvements.
Handy Voice 0.8.10

Changes:
• Simplified the advanced overlay design preview into one live preview block with compact style selection.
• Keeps the existing Handy Voice fork improvements from previous 0.8.x builds.
